inventedEvidence.evidence: 'there is an active electrical safety warning on this appliance (a supply trip hazard)' and 'Please don't keep resetting the trip' - customer said no tripping and no resetting

rationale: The early diagnosis (heater or thermal cut-out, cold drum, 4kg load) was reasonable, but the assistant then invented a supply trip hazard and told the customer to stop resetting a trip, contradicting what she said (no tripping, no resetting). It repeated this even after she objected, leaving her confused. The escalation to an engineer ends up broadly right, but it rests on a false premise. The assistant also never asked about the interrupted drying cycle or offered the useful model-based guidance on the cut-out, so the customer got little help.
